heal_light.name: Mend
heal_light.description: A gentle healing light restores a small amount of HP.

heal_medium.name: Restore
heal_medium.description: A warm pulse of energy mends wounds and soothes pain.

heal_full.name: Full Restore
heal_full.description: A brilliant flash of divine light fully restores your body.

calm_bladder.name: Calm Bladder
calm_bladder.description: Magically soothes urgency, reducing bladder pressure.

settle_tummy.name: Settle Tummy
settle_tummy.description: A warm magical glow calms your tummy and eases cramps.

refresh.name: Refresh
refresh.description: A burst of energy that restores stamina and clears your head.

fortify.name: Fortify
fortify.description: Hardens your skin with a magical barrier, raising DEF for 5 turns.

empower.name: Empower
empower.description: Channels arcane strength into your limbs, raising STR for 5 turns.

haste.name: Haste
haste.description: Quickens your reflexes with magical speed, raising DEX for 5 turns.

fireball.name: Fireball
fireball.description: Hurls a blazing sphere of fire at the enemy!

ice_shard.name: Ice Shard
ice_shard.description: Launches jagged shards of ice at the enemy!

poison_cloud.name: Poison Cloud
poison_cloud.description: Envelops the enemy in a toxic miasma that eats away at them over time.

shadow_bolt.name: Shadow Bolt
shadow_bolt.description: A crackling bolt of dark energy slams into the enemy!

smite.name: Smite
smite.description: Calls down a pillar of divine light to punish the wicked!

weaken.name: Weaken
weaken.description: Curses the enemy, lowering their attack power for 4 turns.

corrode.name: Corrode
corrode.description: Acid eats away at the enemy's armor, lowering their DEF for 4 turns.

curse_wet.name: Wetness Curse
curse_wet.description: A hex that floods the bladder with supernatural urgency.

divine_urge.name: Divine Urge
divine_urge.description: A prayer-channeled supernatural pressure builds in your bladder.

haunting_urge.name: Haunting Urge
haunting_urge.description: A ghostly presence whispers urgency into your body.

sacred_cramp.name: Sacred Cramp
sacred_cramp.description: A blessed ache radiates through your stomach. Your tummy protests.

mandatory_feeding.name: Mandatory Feeding
mandatory_feeding.description: Something goes in whether you want it to or not. Your stomach fills uncomfortably.

sparkle_shame.name: Sparkle of Shame
sparkle_shame.description: Glittering dust settles on you and suddenly you feel very seen.

shadow_shame.name: Shadow of Shame
shadow_shame.description: A cold dark presence reminds you of every embarrassing moment at once.

public_shame.name: Public Shaming
public_shame.description: An announcement rings out. Everyone is looking. The floor does not open up.

social_documentation.name: Social Documentation
social_documentation.description: Your condition is noted, catalogued, and shared with the class.

assessment_scan.name: Assessment Scan
assessment_scan.description: Your measurements are taken. Your level of need is logged.

fear_pulse.name: Fear Pulse
fear_pulse.description: A wave of wrongness passes through you. Your heart races.

nerve_amplify.name: Nerve Amplify
nerve_amplify.description: Every sensation is turned up. Your body betrays you in an entirely different way.

deep_hex.name: Deep Hex
deep_hex.description: A layered curse sinks into you. Control slips just a little further away.

hypnotic_pulse.name: Hypnotic Pulse
hypnotic_pulse.description: A wave of bioluminescent light washes over you. Your reflexes go soft.

detention_gaze.name: Detention Gaze
detention_gaze.description: A withering look freezes you in place. Your movements become clumsy.

ensnare.name: Ensnare
ensnare.description: Something catches your feet. You can barely move.

slime_seep_wet.name: Slime Seep
slime_seep_wet.description: The slime soaks through your clothes. Something about it loosens your grip.

formula_force.name: Formula Force
formula_force.description: Something warm and sweet is pushed past your lips. Your tummy churns.

venom_sting.name: Venom Sting
venom_sting.description: A sharp toxin lances through you. Your stomach cramps sharply.

cage_rattle.name: Cage Rattle
cage_rattle.description: Iron bars slam shut with terrible finality. The sound of your own helplessness echoes.

neural_probe.name: Neural Probe
neural_probe.description: Something maps your memories. Every embarrassing moment is visible. You feel watched and aroused at once.

lullaby_trance.name: Lullaby Trance
lullaby_trance.description: A melody so soothing it dissolves your defenses. The shame melts away... along with something else.

light_pulse.name: Light Pulse
light_pulse.description: A rhythmic glow makes you feel uncomfortably warm. Your guard slips.

injection_protocol.name: Injection Protocol
injection_protocol.description: A needle finds a vein before you can protest. Something spreads cold through your veins.

serum_injection.name: Serum Injection
serum_injection.description: A clinical injection. The compound is labeled 'R-7'. It works immediately.

treatment_protocol.name: Treatment Protocol
treatment_protocol.description: A full procedure. Phase one hurts. Phase two doesn't. That's the worrying part.

mild_trance.name: Mild Trance
mild_trance.description: A gentle reframing. Some of the shame dissolves. Something else rises in its place.

deep_trance.name: Deep Trance
deep_trance.description: You go somewhere else. The shame is far away. So is everything else.

lullaby_syrup.name: Lullaby Syrup
lullaby_syrup.description: Something sweet is pressed to your lips. Warmth spreads. Your legs feel heavy. Shame floods in after.

restraint_hold.name: Restraint Hold
restraint_hold.description: Something grabs and pins you. You can barely move, and the struggling only makes it hurt.

mop_splash.name: Mop Splash
mop_splash.description: A mop bucket tips — intentionally — right at you. Wet and humiliated.

spectral_chill.name: Spectral Chill
spectral_chill.description: A ghost passes through you. Cold and shame come with it.

ecto_seep.name: Ecto Seep
ecto_seep.description: Ectoplasm soaks through your clothing with unpleasant warmth.

triple_blessing.name: Triple Blessing
triple_blessing.description: Three acolytes speak in unison. Wet, tum, and nerve pathways all respond at once.

sweeping_trip.name: Sweeping Trip
sweeping_trip.description: Knocks the target into crawling. Stand Up spends one action; physical damage is reduced 25% until then.

auto_strapper.success: The Auto-Strapper's arms retract. A polite tone announces, 'Fit confirmed. No further fastening required.'
auto_strapper.failure: The Auto-Strapper buzzes angrily. 'Subject moving too much. Securing immediately.'

bloated_slime.success: The bloated slime burbles warmly and sloshes off, too charmed to keep fighting.
bloated_slime.failure: The bloated slime quivers, then crashes over you in a sticky wave.

bottle_slime.success: The Bottle Slime wobbles in pleased little circles, then oozes away with a bubbly coo.
bottle_slime.failure: The Bottle Slime ripples with greedy interest and engulfs you before you can pull back.

pacifier_wraith.success: The wraith pauses its humming, drifts back, and dissolves. It'll find someone else tonight.
pacifier_wraith.failure: Something cool and smooth clicks past your lips before you've registered the movement, and then your thoughts begin to round.

diaper_hugger.success: The Diaper-Hugger chirps something pleased, pats at your head, and waddles away without latching.
diaper_hugger.failure: The Diaper-Hugger gets both arms around you before the gesture is even finished, and by the time it lets go you've already been changed.

lullaby_siren.success: The Lullaby Siren trails off mid-refrain, genuinely caught off-guard, and lets you pass with a drowsy smile.
lullaby_siren.failure: The Lullaby Siren simply sings louder, and you stop being able to remember what you were doing.

crib_mimic.success: The Crib Mimic creaks back open and stays still. It's not going to close on you today.
crib_mimic.failure: The slats snap shut before you realize they were moving, and by the time you get out, everything is different.

canyon_raider.success: The Canyon Raider laughs so hard they forget to finish the fight, and you slip away while they recover.
canyon_raider.failure: The Canyon Raider smirks. 'Save that sparkle for a mark who'll pay for it.'

chest_mimic.success: The Chest Mimic snaps shut, rattles happily, and decides the teasing was enough for one meal.
chest_mimic.failure: The Chest Mimic lunges the instant you lean in too close.

cradle_golem.success: The Cradle Golem rocks once, decides you are calm enough, and sets you down gently.
cradle_golem.failure: The Cradle Golem mistakes your attempt for a sleepy fuss and tucks you in by force.

cultist_excess.success: The Cultist of Excess applauds your shamelessness and declares the rite complete.
cultist_excess.failure: The Cultist of Excess opens their arms wide. 'More. Always more.'

cultist_excite.success: The Cultist of Excite shivers, enthralled by your confidence, and backs away to savor it.
cultist_excite.failure: The Cultist of Excite laughs breathlessly. 'Almost. Try again after you break.'

cultist_tum.success: The Cultist of Tum takes your vulnerability as a holy sign and lets you stagger away blessed.
cultist_tum.failure: 'Yes, confess with your body,' the Cultist of Tum whispers, overwhelming you with pressure.

cultist_wet.success: The Cultist of Wet smiles beatifically and releases you to spread the lesson onward.
cultist_wet.failure: 'Not yet sincere enough,' the Cultist of Wet murmurs, flooding your senses.

diaper_dispenser.success: The dispenser bot whirs happily and rolls away after logging you as 'already supplied.'
diaper_dispenser.failure: The dispenser bot opens every compartment at once. 'Emergency fitting required.'

diaper_fairy.success: The Diaper Fairy twirls in delight. 'You are precious. Shoo, before I keep you forever.'
diaper_fairy.failure: The Diaper Fairy claps. 'Too stiff. Too self-conscious. We'll fix that.'

dust_scavenger.success: The Dust Scavenger whistles, impressed by your audacity, and leaves you to your own luck.
dust_scavenger.failure: The Dust Scavenger bares their teeth. 'Pretty face, bad read.'

elder_witch.success: The Elder Witch studies you, amused. 'You learn quickly. Very well. I'll spare you this lesson.'
elder_witch.failure: The Elder Witch's eyes narrow. 'All that effort, and still no poise. Disappointing.'

formula_feeder_bot.success: The Formula Feeder Bot emits a soft chime. 'Feeding response accepted. Ending intervention.'
formula_feeder_bot.failure: The Formula Feeder Bot clamps your shoulders. 'Refusal masked as flirtation. Override engaged.'

ghost.success: The ghost sighs wistfully, gives you a mournful nod, and drifts into the wall.
ghost.failure: The ghost brushes through you with freezing delight, drinking in your failed bravado.

glowroach.success: The Glowroach's lights pulse in a happy rhythm before it skitters harmlessly away.
glowroach.failure: The Glowroach flares bright, dives for your face, and leaves you reeling.

goblin.success: The goblin blinks, snorts, and decides robbing someone else sounds easier.
goblin.failure: 'Aww, it thinks it's pretty.' The goblin cackles, clubs you down, and calls the others over.

goblin_brute.success: The brute grins, gives your cheek a rough pat, and lumbers off with a smug laugh instead of finishing you.
goblin_brute.failure: 'Cute trick. Wrong audience.' The brute grabs you by the scruff and drops you hard.

hospital_doctor.success: The Chrysalis Doctor chuckles behind their mask. 'Unexpected bedside manner. Fine. You may go.'
hospital_doctor.failure: 'Misusing rapport during treatment?' the Doctor says. 'Noted.'

hospital_nurse.success: The Research Nurse's clinical smile turns fond. 'You've had enough excitement. I'll mark this a discharge.'
hospital_nurse.failure: The Research Nurse exhales softly. 'Oh sweetheart, trying that now just proves you need observation.'

hospital_orderly.success: The Orderly smirks, calls you trouble, and lets you slip away while he's still entertained.
hospital_orderly.failure: 'You've got nerve,' the Orderly says, cracking his knuckles. 'Bad timing.'

hospital_researcher.success: The Mind Researcher gets distracted scribbling notes about your social adaptability and forgets to finish the job.
hospital_researcher.failure: The Mind Researcher lights up. 'Oh, a bold test subject. Wonderful.'

hospital_security.success: The security officer huffs out a laugh and chooses paperwork over pursuit.
hospital_security.failure: 'Cute act,' Security says, cinching the restraints tighter. 'Still a security breach.'

hospital_surgeon.success: The Chief Surgeon gives you a long, considering look, then decides your bravado is reward enough.
hospital_surgeon.failure: The Chief Surgeon does not blink. 'No. Hold still.'

hypnotist_adept.success: The Adept Hypnotist smiles knowingly. 'That was very good. You can keep your secrets for today.'
hypnotist_adept.failure: The Adept Hypnotist meets your gaze without blinking. 'Deflection is still deflection.'

hypnotist_master.success: The Master Hypnotist inclines their head. 'At last. Intentional vulnerability. Go, while you still understand it.'
hypnotist_master.failure: The Master Hypnotist smiles like they expected this. 'You wanted control. Interesting choice.'

hypnotist_novice.success: The Novice Hypnotist flushes, loses their cadence, and waves you away before they embarrass themself further.
hypnotist_novice.failure: The Novice Hypnotist swallows hard. 'N-no, wait, I can still do this.' The pendulum swings.

mansion_slime.success: The ectoplasm slime bubbles with lazy affection and dissolves back into the floorboards.
mansion_slime.failure: The ectoplasm slime surges upward, wrapping around your limbs while it quivers with interest.

matron_rosalind_boss.success: Matron Rosalind's smile slips for half a second. 'You are an interesting one, dear. Go on, then. Today.'
matron_rosalind_boss.failure: 'Charm, dear? On *me*?' Matron Rosalind laughs once, sharply. 'How adorable. Sentinels — full cycle.'

nanny_bot.success: The NannyBot chirps. 'Patient displaying cooperative cuteness. Session complete.'
nanny_bot.failure: The NannyBot's speaker crackles. 'Counterfeit compliance detected. Restraining patient.'

nanny_golem.success: The Nanny Golem pauses, scans your earnest pose, and classifies you as 'already soothed.' It stands down.
nanny_golem.failure: The Nanny Golem's eyes brighten. 'Charm response inadequate. Escalating care.'

nanny_sentinel.success: The Sentinel's monitors settle to green. 'Subject pacified. Patrol resuming.'
nanny_sentinel.failure: The Sentinel locks onto you. 'Manipulative behavior logged. Full corrective cycle engaged.'

nursery_witch.success: The Nursery Witch's smile turns indulgent. 'Oh, now that's adorable. Run along before I change my mind.'
nursery_witch.failure: The Nursery Witch laughs softly. 'If you want attention that badly, I'll give it to you properly.'

potty_trainer_bot.success: The Potty Trainer Bot flashes a gold star icon and declares the lesson complete.
potty_trainer_bot.failure: 'Regression behavior detected,' the bot says, pinning you down with cheerful efficiency.

raider_chief.success: The Raider Chief grins like they've met a worthy liar and calls the hunt off out of respect.
raider_chief.failure: 'Good try,' the Raider Chief says. 'Now kneel.'

research_director.success: The Research Director studies your performance, smiles faintly, and decides the data is more valuable with you still active.
research_director.failure: The Research Director steeples their fingers. 'Charming. Also predictable.'

robo_nurse.success: Robo-Nurse pauses mid-procedure. 'Patient morale stabilized. Further treatment postponed.'
robo_nurse.failure: Robo-Nurse tilts its head. 'Seduction subroutine not recognized. Administering compliance care.'

sand_stinger.success: The Sand Stinger hovers, confused by your confidence, then darts off into the dunes.
sand_stinger.failure: The Sand Stinger mistakes your stillness for weakness and drives straight in.

school_janitor.success: The Janitor sighs, blushes just a little, and mutters that he has better things to clean than this fight.
school_janitor.failure: 'Save it for someone who cares,' the Janitor grunts, hauling you off your feet.

school_nurse.success: The School Nurse softens instantly. 'Sweetie, if you can still smile like that, you can go.'
school_nurse.failure: The School Nurse clicks her tongue. 'Honey, if you're trying that while dizzy, you need supervision.'

school_principal.success: The Principal adjusts her glasses and waves you off, deciding the spectacle has made its point already.
school_principal.failure: The Principal's expression hardens. 'Improper conduct on top of insubordination. Unacceptable.'

school_teacher.success: The Teacher folds her arms, clears her throat, and dismisses class early with a stern little smile.
school_teacher.failure: 'Flirting your way out of consequences?' the Teacher says. 'Detention.'

scrap_trapper.success: The Scrap Trapper grins and tips their hat, deciding you'd cause more trouble alive than caught.
scrap_trapper.failure: 'Stand still and look cute for the cage,' the Scrap Trapper says.

shadow_fairy.success: The Shadow Fairy traces your jaw with a cold finger, then vanishes with a pleased whisper.
shadow_fairy.failure: The Shadow Fairy laughs in the dark. 'Not convincing. Not yet.'

teachers_pet.success: Teacher's Pet gasps, utterly smitten, and runs off to daydream about you instead of fighting.
teachers_pet.failure: 'Wow. That was embarrassing,' Teacher's Pet says, before ratting you out and knocking you flat.

teddy_mimic.success: The Teddy Mimic melts into a happy wiggle and lets you go, content with the attention.
teddy_mimic.failure: The Teddy Mimic squeals, pounces, and mauls you with needy little hugs until you crumple.

subject_theta_boss.success: Theta's tentacles slow. Its bioluminescence shifts to a warm amber — it recognizes something gentle in you. The singing stops. It watches you go, lights fading like a lullaby reaching its end.
subject_theta_boss.failure: The lullaby grows louder. You feel your thoughts go soft and cottony, your limbs heavy and compliant, before Theta's embrace becomes inescapable.
